question: Can the cited 2016 Dumagooc and Maug River study be independently reviewed to resolve the 2021 paper's species-count and identification conflicts?

source.title: Fish species composition, distribution and diversity in two selected rivers of Mt. Hamiguitan Range Wildlife Sanctuary (HRWS), San Isidro, Davao Oriental, Mindanao, Philippines
source.citationAsReported: Quimpang, V. T., Opiso, E. M., Tubongbanua Jr., R. M., Salolog, M. C. S., and Amoroso, V. B. (2016). Asian Journal of Biodiversity, 7(1), pages reported inconsistently as 95-111 or 96-111. https://doi.org/10.7828/ajob.v7i1.869

metadataCrossChecks.supports: The later Dapar et al. publisher article cites this 2016 survey and describes its own comparison; it is not a substitute for the 2016 full text.
The NFRDI-hosted 2024 Maduao paper also cites the 2016 article, with a different inclusive page range.

accessAudit.publisherPageAttempt: The journal's current OJS article URL returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge in this research environment. No challenge, login, or access control was bypassed.
accessAudit.pageRangeConflict: The 2021 publisher PDF cites pages 96-111; the 2024 NFRDI bibliography and a checklist citation give 95-111. This remains a metadata conflict, not a content correction.
accessAudit.laterPaperClaims: The 2021 Dapar et al. paper says its own reported richness was lower than Quimpang et al. (2016) and asserts several earlier misidentifications. These are the later paper's claims only; the original 2016 methods, table, names, specimens and voucher trail could not be independently inspected here.

disposition.reason: Only a citation and publisher metadata are verifiable in this pass. The publisher full-text endpoint returned an access challenge, and no item-specific reuse license was confirmed.

nextAction: Keep this source metadata-only unless a normally accessible publisher or institutional repository copy becomes available. Do not use the later 2021 paper's comparison as a replacement for inspecting the original 2016 source, and do not infer that the 2021 discrepancies are resolved.

sources.supports: Later publisher article reference and its authors' stated comparison with the 2016 study; not an independent validation of that study.
Later NFRDI article bibliography citation of the 2016 study and its alternate page range.
Persistent identifier recorded in the later article citations; full-text retrieval was not established in this review.
